Author: <author> <<email>>
Date:   Thu Nov 19 19:47:40 2026 -0700

End an MCP call when its client sends notifications/cancelled

Each request to /mcp gets its own MCP server, so a notifications/cancelled

connection cannot cancel another's call with the same id.

EOF

export type Method = "get" | "post" | "put" | "patch" | "delete";

type Call = {
  service: TicketService;
  actor: Actor;
  key: string;
  query: unknown;
  body: unknown;
  /** Aborted when the caller goes away before the answer is sent. */
  signal?: AbortSignal;
};

export type ApiAction = {
  /** A stable name, for documentation and for tools. */
  name: string;
  method: Method;
  /** The address under /api, in Express form ("/tickets/:key"). */
  path: string;
  summary: string;
  /**
   * The permission it needs, from the capability table in permissions.ts, which says who
   * among people may call it and which agent scope it takes. The service enforces it.
   */
  needs: Action | Action[];
  query?: z.ZodObject;
  body?: z.ZodType;
  /** The status of a successful answer. */
  status?: number;
  /** What a successful answer looks like. A test checks real answers against it. */
  output: z.ZodType;
  /** True for a list that comes in pages; its doors add how to get the next page. */
  paged?: boolean;
  run: (call: Call) => unknown;
};

    name: "list_tickets",
